title: Grasbüschel A
description: Dichtes Grasbüschel mit 96 realen gefalteten und leicht gedrehten Blattspreiten; einzelne geknickte Halme und 18 trockene Strohhalme.

review.notes: Round 1. Good: 0.64 m (inside the 0.15-0.7 m range), mixed green and dry blades, a few thin wispy blades. Defects: (1) form: the blades are wide, flat, straight ribbons that fan out stiffly from one pinched point, like a bouquet in a vase or a yucca; real tufts have narrow blades that curve and droop at different lengths, and a wider base footprint. (2) The close-up shows hard flat-shaded polygon facets with no midrib or fold; give the blades a V-fold or midrib and a few more segments for curvature (2,496 triangles is too few at this size). (3) Color: dark teal-green; shift toward olive with more dry tips (grass_ground/grass_dry). (4) The base ends abruptly at the ground plane with no soil or old leaf sheaths.
